tools.name: twitterx_get_user_by_username
tools.description: Look up an X user by username and return the user object (id, name, description, public metrics). Use this first to get the numeric user id the other tools need. X API: GET /2/users/by/username/{username}.

tools.name: twitterx_get_user
tools.description: Get one X user by numeric id, with the requested user fields. X API: GET /2/users/{id}.

tools.name: twitterx_get_me
tools.description: Return the X account that owns the token. Needs a user-context OAuth 2.0 access token; an app-only Bearer Token gets an error. X API: GET /2/users/me.

tools.name: twitterx_get_followers
tools.description: List the followers of a user, one page at a time (up to 1000 per page). Follow meta.next_token for more. X API: GET /2/users/{id}/followers.

tools.name: twitterx_get_following
tools.description: List the accounts one user follows, one page at a time (up to 1000 per page). X API: GET /2/users/{id}/following.

tools.name: twitterx_get_post
tools.description: Get one X post by numeric id, with the requested post fields and expansions. X API: GET /2/tweets/{id}.

tools.name: twitterx_get_posts
tools.description: Get up to 100 X posts in one call from a comma list of numeric ids. X API: GET /2/tweets?ids=.

tools.name: twitterx_search_recent_posts
tools.description: Search X posts from the last 7 days with the X query language (operators such as from:, to:, lang:, -is:retweet). Returns up to 100 posts per page. X API: GET /2/tweets/search/recent.

tools.name: twitterx_get_user_posts
tools.description: List the posts of one user, newest first, one page at a time. Replies and retweets can be excluded. X API: GET /2/users/{id}/tweets.

tools.name: twitterx_get_user_mentions
tools.description: List posts that mention one user, one page at a time. X API: GET /2/users/{id}/mentions.

tools.name: twitterx_get_liked_posts
tools.description: List the posts one user liked, one page at a time. X API: GET /2/users/{id}/liked_tweets.

tools.name: twitterx_create_post
tools.description: Publish one post from the authenticated account, only when the user asks for it. Needs a user-context access token and uses pay-per-usage credits. Set reply_to_post_id to reply to a post. X API: POST /2/tweets.

tools.name: twitterx_delete_post
tools.description: Delete one post from the authenticated account, only when the user asks for it. This cannot be undone. Needs a user-context access token. X API: DELETE /2/tweets/{id}.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "twitterx_get_me" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Return the X account that owns the token. Needs a user-context OAuth 2.0 access token; an app-only Bearer Token gets an error. X API: GET /2/users/me.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: twitterx_get_post, twitterx_get_posts, twitterx_search_recent_posts, twitterx_get_user_posts, twitterx_get_user_mentions, twitterx_get_liked_posts · Private data: twitterx_get_me, twitterx_create_post, twitterx_delete_post · Public sink: twitterx_get_post, twitterx_create_post, twitterx_delete_post · Destructive: twitterx_delete_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: twitterx_get_post, twitterx_get_posts, twitterx_search_recent_posts, twitterx_get_user_posts, twitterx_get_user_mentions, twitterx_get_liked_posts · Private data: twitterx_get_me, twitterx_create_post, twitterx_delete_post · Public sink: twitterx_get_post, twitterx_create_post, twitterx_delete_post · Destructive: twitterx_delete_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
